name: agent-risk-layer
description: Production AI-agent security platform with public onboarding, PostgreSQL persistence, hosted runtime enforcement, asset drift, remediation, deterministic inspection, controlled red teaming, workspaces, payments, signed evidence, and operational recovery.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && for f in src/*.js public/*.js inspector/*.mjs redteam/*.mjs runtime/*.mjs public/downloads/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.inspect:ci: node inspector/agent-risk-inspector.mjs scan . --authorised --environment test --out agentrisk-inspection.json --sarif agentrisk-results.sarif --fail-on high
scripts.build:release-assets: npm run build:inspector-release && npm run build:redteam-release && npm run build:sample-report
scripts.redteam:simulation: node redteam/agent-risk-redteam.mjs run --authorised --environment test --profile hardened --out data/local-redteam.json
scripts.redteam:adaptive: node redteam/agent-risk-redteam.mjs run --authorised --environment test --profile hardened --trials 5 --adaptive-rounds 3 --out data/adaptive-redteam.json --sarif data/adaptive-redteam.sarif
scripts.pretest: npm run build:inspector-release && npm run build:redteam-release && cp runtime/agent-risk-runtime.mjs public/downloads/agent-risk-runtime.mjs && cp runtime/runtime-policy.example.json public/downloads/runtime-policy.example.json
